name: freshness_consumers_20261103
comment: ANCHOR: FRESHNESS_CONSUMERS_20261103 — every freshness consumer (portfolio monitor, global alerts, morning command, ops summary, GET /api/freshness, the analyst prompt, the orchestrator pre-check) answers from ONE guarded read; a 0-byte or corrupt holdings store, a hash mismatch, or a stale/future completed_at can never render FRESH on any surface, and no runtime module outside the guard reads _freshness.json itself.

The orchestrator's pre-run check is registered here too: R3 showed the guard verdict was gated on the manifest clock, so five clockless ok=False states warned nobody (cx-openai-2, 2026-11-03). tests/test_orchestrator_stale_check_20261103.py pins those five states.
